title: Integrated analysis of single-cell and bulk RNA-seq data identifies NR4A1-associated macrophages in immunoglobulin A nephropathy.
authors: Zhang, Xueqin; Chao, Peng; Zhang, Lei; Zhao, Yang; Li, Hui; Zhou, Yipeng; Song, Xue; Yang, Shufen; Muhetaer, Gulimire; Jiang, Hong; Lu, Chen
one_liner_zh: 该研究整合单细胞和bulk RNA-seq数据识别IgA肾病中NR4A1相关巨噬细胞，虽涉及转录因子ZBTB7A与NR4A1的蛋白互作，但核心是疾病诊断与功能实验，无蛋白质-DNA结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Immunoglobulin A nephropathy (IgAN), the most prevalent primary glomerulonephritis worldwide, is characterized by chronic renal inflammation and progressive decline toward end-stage renal disease. In this study, we integrated single-cell and bulk RNA sequencing approaches to systematically elucidate the role of macrophages in IgAN pathogenesis. Single-cell transcriptomic analysis identified 171 macrophage-associated differentially expressed genes and revealed two distinct molecular subtypes with divergent immune and metabolic signatures. Using machine learning algorithms, we constructed a diagnostic model based on eight macrophage-related markers, including NR4A1, which demonstrated robust predictive accuracy (Area Under the Curve > 0.9) across multiple independent validation cohorts. Functional experiments further established NR4A1 as a protective factor in IgAN. Overexpression of NR4A1 in an IgAN mouse model markedly reduced renal fibrosis, macrophage infiltration, and glomerular injury, whereas NR4A1 knockout exacerbated these pathological features. Mechanistically, the transcription factor ZBTB7A, which is upregulated in IgAN, directly suppresses NR4A1 expression through protein interaction. Rescue experiments demonstrated that NR4A1 overexpression mitigates ZBTB7A-induced renal damage. Collectively, these findings identify the ZBTB7A-NR4A1 regulatory axis as a critical mechanism driving IgAN progression and highlight NR4A1 as a potential diagnostic biomarker and therapeutic target for disease prevention.
abstract_zh: 免疫球蛋白A肾病（IgAN）是全球最常见的原发性肾小球肾炎，以慢性肾脏炎症和向终末期肾病进行性恶化为特征。在本研究中，我们整合了单细胞和批量RNA测序方法，系统阐明巨噬细胞在IgAN发病机制中的作用。单细胞转录组分析鉴定出171个巨噬细胞相关的差异表达基因，并揭示了两种具有不同免疫和代谢特征的分子亚型。利用机器学习算法，我们构建了一个基于八个巨噬细胞相关标志物（包括NR4A1）的诊断模型，该模型在多个独立验证队列中展现出稳健的预测准确性（曲线下面积 > 0.9）。功能实验进一步确立了NR4A1作为IgAN中的保护因子。在IgAN小鼠模型中过表达NR4A1显著减少了肾纤维化、巨噬细胞浸润和肾小球损伤，而NR4A1敲除则加剧了这些病理特征。机制上，在IgAN中上调的转录因子ZBTB7A通过蛋白质相互作用直接抑制NR4A1表达。拯救实验表明，NR4A1过表达可缓解ZBTB7A诱导的肾脏损伤。综合来看，这些发现将ZBTB7A-NR4A1调控轴确定为驱动IgAN进展的关键机制，并强调NR4A1作为疾病预防的潜在诊断生物标志物和治疗靶点。
